source_citation: McKesson Corporation Form 8-K accepted 2023-11-01 16:05:42 ET. Exhibit mck_exhibit991x9302023.htm (quarter ending 2023-09-30) is headed MCKESSON CORPORATION REPORTS FISCAL 2024 SECOND QUARTER RESULTS AND RAISES FULL YEAR GUIDANCE and states: a conference call for today, Wednesday, November 1st at 4:30 PM ET.
notes_caveats: CORRECTS a mis-dated derived row. The 8-K bundles items 2.02, 5.02, 7.01 and 9.01; reportDate 2023-10-27 is the date of the Item 5.02 officer departure, not the earnings release. The release is the acceptance date, 2023-11-01, AMC on a 16:05 ET acceptance with the call at 16:30 ET. Resolving this required READING the press release -- the acceptance timestamp alone cannot separate released that evening from filed days late, which is why the classifier refuses the different-day case rather than inferring through it.
